jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Technical Product Management
jobs.description:
Job Description

**The Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.

* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.


Our Technology centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of the company IT operating model, Tech centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.


A focused group of leaders in each tech center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.

**Role Overview:**


We are seeking a skilled SAP Order to Cash Sr Specialist to help analyze, design, implement and support SAP OTC processes within our organization. The ideal candidate will use their knowledge of SAP OTC to ensure the seamless integration of order management, pricing, billing, and accounts receivable processes while collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.

**What will you do in this role:**

* Serve as SME in the design, configuration, testing, and deployment of SAP Order to Cash (OTC) processes including order management, pricing, delivery, invoicing, and receivables.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, translating them into SAP functional designs and solutions.
* Provide technical expertise to Product Managers and Product Line Lead to ensure alignment to the template end\-to\-end OTC design, ensuring alignment with business goals and SAP best practices.
* Review the Configuration and customization in the SAP SD (Sales \& Distribution) and other relevant modules to meet the needs of the business.
* Accountable for data migration, system upgrades, and ongoing maintenance in the OTC.
* Troubleshoot and resolve SAP OTC related issues, providing root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with relevant IT policies, standards, and audit requirements.
* Provide Knowledge transfer and training on delivered capabilities to business and IT peers

**What Should you have:**

* **Primary Skills :** SAP OTC / SD configuration experience, order management, pricing, delivery, invoicing, and receivables.
* **Secondary Skills**: Integration (EDI, IDOCs, APIs, migration) Experience in product model environments and familiarity with Agile tools like JIRA
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 4\+ years of experience working with SAP, including strong configuration expertise in SAP SD processes.
* Proven experience in SAP Order to Cash implementations, upgrades, and support in large\-scale environments.
* Experience working in cross\-functional teams and global teams in complex, matrixed organizations.
* Knowledge of EDI, IDOCs, BTP and APIs for OTC integrations.
* Understanding of tax integration (e.g., Thomson Reuters) is a plus.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to contribute to multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing tasks effectively and participating in various project phases, including Solution Design, Testing, Cutover, and Go\-Live.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Knowledge of Agile methodologies is a plus.
* Background in the Life Sciences or pharmaceutical industry.
* Familiarity with project management / testing tools such as JIRA, HP/ALM, X\-Ray or ServiceNow.
* Experience in SAP S/4 a plus

**Who we are:**


We are known as Merck \& Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.

**What we look for:**


Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Sales Ops Analyst**
**Job Description**
-----------------------------------------

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail\-oriented Analyst to support the integration of new products, new business units, and evolving product offerings into the company’s standard quoting process. This role is critical to ensuring that new products are launched with clear quoting requirements, accurate configuration logic, proper documentation, and effective training for internal teams. This role is critical to our go\-to\-market process and bridges the gap between early\-stage product configurations and scalable enterprise systems.  



The ***Sales Ops Analyst*** will be based in Hyderabad, IN. In this position, you will report to a ***Sr Sales Operations Manager*** . You will be responsible for supporting accurate and timely estimating and quoting, and helping integrate new product lines, and regional requirements into standard quoting processes. You will own the creation of dynamic, logic\-driven Excel tools that serve both immediate quoting needs and the design of long\-term systems such as CPQ platforms and web\-based quoting applications. Strong technical, analytical, and cross\-functional communication skills are essential to succeed in this highly visible role. You will work closely with Global Sales teams and Sales\-supporting departments such as Product, Finance, Supply Chain, Logistics, Commercial Operations, and IT.  



**We are looking for someone who demonstrates:**

* Excellent communication skills
* High\-level reporting capabilities
* Love of analysis and infographics
* Strong attention to detail
* Excel in fast\-paced high\-pressure environment
* Passionate drive to innovate and create
* Consistent interactive teamwork
* Desire for continuous improvement, top performance and winning
* Thoughtful, fast, disciplined execution
* Relentless customer focus
* Integrity as a core value
Interest in exploring and utilizing Artificial Intelligence (AI) to drive innovation and scale processes  
* 

**Here is a glimpse of what you’ll do…** 

i. Support accurate, timely, and scalable quoting for commercial opportunities, early\-stage products, unreleased products, and service offerings across multiple product lines.
 

ii. Perform requirement gathering and documentation to enable development of Excel\-based quoting tools that improve quoting speed, accuracy, governance, and scalability.
 

iii. Implement complex logic and configuration rules to support product structures, pricing models, approval workflows, regional requirements, and New BU integration needs.
 

iv. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Sales, Finance, IT, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Commercial Operations teams to gather requirements and translate them into quoting logic and scalable process documentation.
 

v. Serve as a bridge to enterprise quoting systems by ensuring quoting logic, tool structure, product requirements, and product configuration rules can be ported into or inform CPQ systems, web\-based quoting platforms, and digital configuration tools.
 

vi. Support integrating new product into standard quoting processes, including data mapping, product configuration alignment, pricing logic, user training, testing, rollout support, and change management.
 

vii. Support CPQ systems, including Salesforce CPQ, Oracle CPQ, or similar platforms, as well as web\-based quoting platforms and digital configuration tools.
 

viii. Document quoting logic, product integration requirements, tool architecture, and configuration assumptions for future system migrations and enterprise implementations.
 

ix. Ensure quoting tools are scalable, accurate, and robust, including version control, error handling, regression testing, and governance controls.
 

x. Provide training, rollout support, and user feedback integration for internal stakeholders, and end\-users.
 

xi. Explore the use of AI\-powered features, including intelligent autofill, anomaly detection, or predictive quoting logic, to enhance tool accuracy and process efficiency.


Partner with Commercial Operations, Product, Finance, IT, and Sales teams to design quoting workflows that can scale across regions, product lines, Business Units, and enterprise systems .  

* 

**Here is some of what you’ll need (required)…**

Preferred experience:
 

i. Bachelor’s degree with 5 years’ experience or
 

ii. Master’s degree with 3 years’ experience or
 

iii. PhD without experience or equivalent work experience


* Experience building or supporting quoting tools for commercial, unreleased, pre\-commercial, or newly integrated products.
* Strong understanding of data cleansing, normalization, product configuration logic, quoting rules, pricing logic, and workflow governance.
* Ability to work in fast\-paced dynamic environments with evolving product definitions and short iteration cycles.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to work across engineering, commercial, and IT stakeholders.
* Strong time management, organization, and documentation habits.
Ability to evaluate and incorporate AI tools or frameworks into data analysis or quoting workflows.  
* 

**Here are a few of our preferred experiences…** 

i. MBA is preferred or equivalent experience.
 

ii. Experience and strong orientation toward Analysis and customer services
 

iii. Experience in a startup environment as well as global public companies
 

iv. Familiarity with CPQ platforms (Salesforce CPQ, Oracle CPQ, or similar).
 

v. Experience working on web\-based quoting or configuration tools.
 

vi. Exposure to database tools (e.g., SQL, ODBC), API integrations, or cloud\-based Excel systems (Office 365, SharePoint).
 

vii. Background in hardware, manufacturing, renewable energy, or other configuration\-heavy industries.
 

viii. Experience in the Solar Industry is always a plus.

jobs.title: Custody Product Development - International payment hub and gateway - AVP
jobs.description:
**Who are we looking for**


The Product organization is recruiting for an experienced individual covering areas of our core banking and payments platforms and related integration services under the Cash, Payments and Liquidity (CPL) Product Development team.


The individual will partner with the Product Development team, Global Delivery (operations) and Technology to focus on the core platforms and/or the integration layer to support the building of a modern banking and payment model in alignment with our strategic objective to strengthen State Street’s position in the industry. State Street’s product organization is leading an exciting period of transformation for the business and requires experienced individuals to support the business.

  



The role will support the design and development of the Gateway integration layer to enable upstream and downstream interfaces and the decommission of legacy platforms following the successful branch migrations. This will be key to support client growth, enhance client experience and our operating model.


Selected candidate will perform as a Product Owner for an Agile team and manage the collection of input from subject matter experts, operations teams, product managers, client service teams and/or our clients for the purpose of developing complete and substantive business requirements. Role also requires the ability to document use cases and operational flows acting as gatekeeper to ensure quality documentation is generated and any shortcomings are addressed prior to releasing the material for downstream use. Development of efficient operating models that include effective business controls will be a job function of the successful candidate, as well as an integration strategy to ensure we have a standard interface catalogue based on defined data standards.


The role requires depth and expertise to effectively develop requirements/stories, develop and groom the backlog for development, drive solutions and have the SME knowledge to execute on the overall custody product development agenda. The role will support the Cash, Payments and Liquidity Product Development lead, focusing on payments banking and/or integration with surrounding technology.

***What you will be responsible for***


The role will have responsibility for the following

* Act as the Product Owner leading work required to accelerate the Gateway development and integration with enterprise applications and/or support other banking \& payment deliverables.
* Support the development and analysis of product\-related change, including commercially viable and client focused business cases.
* Ensure change remains aligned to existing regulation and/or internal policies.
* Requires understanding of local requirements for both deployment and ongoing regulatory compliance.
* Support design and efficiency of the operating model, standards and technical stack/architecture, with an objective to simplify where possible working with Product Management, Technology and Global Delivery.
* Lead and direct the agile team members working on defect identification, triage and remediation including identification of root cause and resolution management as appropriate.
* Support annual planning and funding prioritization activities where required.
* Oversee archival of documentation and other program artifacts associated with development and implementation activities so that they are maintained for future business needs and audit purposes


what we value

* Ability to apply knowledge of system behavior and business requirements as well as industry knowledge and best practices to design and test solutions
* Ability to clearly articulate impact of any changes to team members, testers and business end users to ensure that testing and acceptance processes are completed successfully
* Ability to oversee, review and edit documentation to ensure completeness and clarity prior to submitting for use in developing solutions
* Ability to write Agile stories and epics, establish a backlog and groom that backlog is desired as is experience with developing these skills in our global team
* Work well within a virtual team that includes members from across State Streets global operations, product and IT development teams, contractors, software vendors and other industry participants to design, develop, test and implement solutions that support current and future business requirements
* Subject matter knowledge, particularly areas of business process in the payments and banking space.
* Strong analytical skills
* Prior experience of successfully delivering change in a complex environment whilst managing competing environments, and delivering projects using Agile and Waterfall techniques
* Proven change agent with track record of delivery
* Strong stakeholder management skills with an ability to navigate organisation through the solution delivery cycle

**Preferred Experience and Qualifications**

* Product and operational background or experience with payments and deposit banking and understanding of business needs to support integration with platforms
* Experience with developing and implementing banking platforms is desirable as is a level of technical familiarity with messaging standards such as: ISO 20022 pacs and camt; and building out of interfaces catalogues
* Agile experience as a Product Owner or Principle Product Owner is desired
* Seasoned AVP with 3\-5 \+ years’ experience in Securities Services or Banking/Payments
* Worked in Product organizations in prior roles is desired
* Operated at a global level
* Prior experience working in Operations and/or technology

**Outcomes expected from the roles**

* Good understanding of payments and deposit banking products, especially data requirements to build the integration service
* Proactive input and idea generation for product development roadmap
* Maintain up to date understanding of local regulatory impacts and standards
* Responsible for issue and risk escalati…

 **Department \- Customer**

We are seeking a Digital Success Manager who is responsible for driving customer adoption, engagement, and retention across a digital\-first customer segment. This role operates at scale, using data, automation, and digital touchpoints to deliver proactive success outcomes across a large portfolio of accounts — without relying on high\-touch, one\-to\-one engagement for every interaction.


Responsibilities:
* Own the end\-to\-end digital customer journey for a defined customer segment (typically SMB or low\-ARR accounts), from onboarding through renewal and expansion.
* Design and execute automated lifecycle campaigns (email, in\-app, webinars) that drive product adoption and feature awareness at scale.
* Monitor customer health scores and usage data to identify at\-risk accounts and trigger appropriate digital or human interventions.
* Collaborate with CS, Product, and Marketing teams to develop self\-serve resources including knowledge bases, video tutorials, and help content.
* Manage and continuously optimise digital engagement programs using tools such as Gainsight, Totango, HubSpot, or similar platforms.
* Analyse cohort data and engagement metrics to identify trends, surface insights, and iterate on program performance.
* Triage and escalate accounts appropriately when digital engagement signals indicate the need for human\-led outreach.
* Support onboarding at scale through guided in\-app experiences, automated check\-in sequences, and digital office hours or webinars.
* Partner with Renewals and Sales to flag expansion signals or churn risk within the digital segment.


Skills and Experience:
* 3–5 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related SaaS role.
* Demonstrated experience managing or contributing to a digital/tech\-touch CS program.
* Comfort working with customer health data, CRM platforms, and CS automation tools.
* Strong written communication skills — able to craft compelling, scalable messaging for diverse customer segments.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and translate it into actionable program changes.
* A customer\-first orientation with the ability to drive outcomes without relying solely on direct relationship management.

Ideagen is the invisible force behind many things we rely on every day \- from keeping airplanes soaring in the sky, to ensuring the food on our tables is safe, to helping doctors and nurses care for the sick. We have offices all over the world including America, Australia, Malaysia and India with people doing lots of different and exciting jobs.  

We’re building a future\-ready team, and AI is part of how we work smarter. If you're curious, adaptable and open to using AI to improve how you work, you’ll thrive at Ideagen! **What is next?**  

If your application meets the requirements for this role, our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch to guide you through the next steps.
To ensure a flexible and inclusive process, please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments by contacting us at recruitment@ideagen.com. All matters will be treated with strict confidence.  

At Ideagen, we value the importance of work\-life balance and welcome candidates seeking flexible or part\-time working arrangements. If this is something you are interested in, please let us know during the application process.

jobs.title: Developer III
jobs.description:
Overview:

RealPage is looking for a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join our Lumina Copilot team to help design and build our AI\-powered chat application. This role involves working across the full stack — from Svelte and Web Component\-based frontends to Node.js APIs on GCP — with a strong emphasis on LLM integration, prompt engineering, and agentic AI patterns.


Responsibilities:
* Work with our cross\-functional team of developers, designers, and product owners to develop and maintain our AI\-powered copilot platform.
* Build and extend LLM\-driven features including RAG pipelines, tool\-calling agents, prompt management, and streaming chat interfaces.
* Develop UI using SvelteKit, Web Components (custom elements), and TypeScript — building standards\-based, framework\-agnostic components that integrate into host applications across different browsers.
* Integrate with LLM providers (OpenAI) to implement chat completions, embeddings, real\-time voice interactions, and content moderation guardrails.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Chatbot for ERP Data
jobs.description:
Amotion AI builds AI products for large enterprises. Our client for which we are hiring is building a product \- an AI chatbot that lets SAP users ask business questions in plain English and get accurate answers from their own data — no SQL knowledge needed, no data analyst required.
 



  





 The product is live, processing real queries in production. It converts plain\-English questions into database queries, verifies the results before showing them, and achieves 99\.5% query execution accuracy across 354 tested business scenarios. We are hiring a Technical PM to help scale it and build the product further based on market demand and requirements.
 



  





**The role** 




 You sit between product strategy and engineering. Your job is to take what the product needs to do and turn it into clear, detailed requirements that engineers can build from. You then track that work through to delivery.
 



  





**What you will own** 



* Writing detailed product requirements — user stories, API specs, acceptance criteria — for the core AI query engine, the business language layer, and enterprise customer integrations
* Managing the active backlog, setting sprint priorities, and coordinating releases across product phases
* Collecting and structuring requirements from paying enterprise customers across the Middle East and Southeast Asia
* Working with engineering on the accuracy testing system — how the chatbot's query performance is measured, tracked, and improved over time
* Coordinating security certification work (SOC 2, ISO 27001\) into the product roadmap



  





**What we need from you** 



* 5\+ years in product management, with at least 2 years as a Technical PM on a B2B SaaS product
* Ability to write specs engineers build from directly — data models, API definitions, edge cases, error conditions
* Comfortable reading code, database schemas, and system design documents without needing them translated
* Experience running a technical backlog with a structured prioritization system
* Direct customer\-facing PM experience — discovery calls, requirement gathering, managing conflicting inputs from multiple stakeholders



  





**Good to have** 



* Background in data, analytics, BI, or developer tools (Snowflake, dbt, PowerBI, Databricks, or similar)
* Familiarity with AI products built on large language models, especially tools that generate SQL or code from natural language
* Working knowledge of SAP and other ERPs
* Exposure to enterprise deployment requirements such as role\-based access controls, audit logging, or fully offline (air\-gapped) environments

jobs.description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting\-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?**  

Role Overview  



The Principal Network Engineer will be a senior individual contributor (IC4\) within Keyloop's Network Engineering team, based in Hyderabad, India. This role provides deep technical ownership of Keyloop’s global corporate network infrastructure — spanning SD\-WAN, cloud security, wireless, and VPN — while playing a critical part in growing and developing the network engineering capability within the Hyderabad location.

  



Working closely with the Network Engineering Manager, this individual is the primary corporate network authority for Keyloop's India operations, providing mentoring and technical development to both the local Network Engineering team and the Hyderabad IT Support team. The role also involves supporting legacy voice decommissioning and migration to modern unified communications platforms.



### **Roles \& Responsiblities**



**Network Infrastructure \& Architecture**



* Design, implement, and maintain Keyloop's global corporate network infrastructure, ensuring high availability, performance, and security across all office and hub sites.
* Own the architecture and ongoing optimisation of corporate SD\-WAN deployments, connecting Keyloop’s office locations and enabling secure corporate connectivity.
* Administer and evolve Keyloop’s switching, wireless, and security appliance estate across the global corporate office footprint.
* Manage and maintain corporate VPN solutions for Keyloop’s \~2,775 users across 29 countries.
* Lead the design and implementation of network changes and projects, maintaining full documentation including topology diagrams, IP address management (IPAM), and configuration standards.
* Implement and enforce network security controls, working in close partnership with the Information Security team and the organisation’s cloud network security and secure web proxy platform.

  



**Cloud Network Security \& Secure Access**



* Maintain working knowledge of Keyloop’s cloud network security and secure web proxy platform — how internet and private access policies are structured and enforced — sufficient to support troubleshooting and act as an informed partner to the Information Security team.
* Stay current with the organisation’s cloud security posture to identify and flag network\-layer issues affecting policy effectiveness or user connectivity, escalating to the relevant owner as appropriate.
* Apply Zero Trust principles and network segmentation thinking to corporate network design, ensuring access controls, traffic isolation, and least\-privilege connectivity are treated as standard practice.

  



**Legacy Voice \& Unified Communications Migration**



* Support the assessment and decommissioning of legacy voice systems across Keyloop’s global estate, contributing technical input to the decommissioning roadmap.
* Assist in the technical delivery of migrations from legacy voice platforms to modern unified cloud communications solutions, providing hands\-on support and technical expertise as required.

  



**Team Development, People Leadership \& Mentoring**



* Serve as the senior technical point of reference and informal people lead for the Hyderabad Network Engineering team, providing day\-to\-day guidance, technical mentorship, and career development support.
* Own a structured networking skills development programme for the Hyderabad IT Support team — delivering training sessions, shadowing opportunities, and competency assessments covering network fundamentals, fault diagnosis, escalation, and documentation standards.
* Contribute to the development of standard operating procedures, runbooks, and training materials for the wider IT team.

The main function of the role is: Work in conjunction with individuals on the team as well as other Shared Services/COEs, outsource partners, Client Service, other business units as needed to ensure seamless processing according to the fund’s policies, to ensure NAV accuracy and that all SLAs are met

From core custody, accounting, fund administration and shareholder recordkeeping, to complete operations solutions and servicing for alternative assets like OTC derivatives, private equity and real estate, SSGS’ tools help our clients make better investment choices and act on growth opportunities.


Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

Good understanding of financial services and investment products  

Excellent Communication Skills  

Problem Solving \& Analytical Skills  

Ability to work on MS Office (Excel, Word and PPT)

Graduate degree in Business, Accounting, Finance or equivalent experience preferred

At ProArch, we partner with businesses around the world to turn big ideas into better outcomes through IT services that span cybersecurity, cloud, data, AI, and app development. We're 400\+ team members strong across 3 countries (we call ourselves ProArchians)—and here's what connects us all:
   

  

* A love for solving real business problems
* A belief in doing what's right


**What's it like to work here?**
* You'll keep growing. You'll work alongside domain experts who love to share what they know
* You'll be supported, heard, and trusted to make an impact
* You'll take on projects that touch industries, communities, and lives
* You'll have the time to focus on what matters most in your life outside of work


 At ProArch, you'll be part of teams that design and deliver technology solutions solving real business challenges for our clients. With services spanning AI, Data, Application Development, Cybersecurity, Cloud \& Infrastructure, and Industry Solutions, your work may involve building intelligent applications, securing business‑critical systems, or supporting cloud migrations and infrastructure modernization.
   

  

 Every role here contributes to shaping outcomes for global clients and driving meaningful impact. You'll collaborate with experts across data, AI, engineering, cloud, cybersecurity, and infrastructure—solving complex problems with creativity, precision, and purpose. You'll join a culture rooted in technology, curiosity, and continuous learning. A place where we move fast, trust you to make an impact, encourage innovation, and support your growth.
   

  

**Job Description:**
 We are looking a Senior Data Product Owner to lead the delivery and strategic development of data\-driven products and platforms. This role will bridge the gap between business needs and technical implementation—owning the product lifecycle, translating business requirements into data solutions, and ensuring the integrity of data models and analytics pipelines, especially within the Azure ecosystem.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Define and prioritize the product backlog for data\-driven initiatives, focusing on measurable business outcomes
* Act as a key liaison between business stakeholders, data engineers, data scientists, and analytics teams
* Lead data product development using Agile methodologies, driving sprint planning, backlog grooming, and stakeholder reviews
* Analyze complex business requirements and translate them into scalable data models and solutions
* Drive the design and validation of robust data models, ensuring high data quality and consistency
* Collaborate with Azure data platform teams to deliver secure, efficient, and scalable cloud\-based data solutions
* Monitor and measure the performance of data products, ensuring alignment with KPIs and business goals
* Champion data governance, quality, and compliance practices across all stages of the product lifecycle


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field
* 6\+ years of experience in Data/Analytics/BI roles, with 3\+ years in a Product Owner or Business Analyst capacity
* Strong understanding of data modelling (relational, dimensional, and modern NoSQL/data lake concepts)
* Hands\-on experience with Azure Data Services (Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure SQL, Data Lake, etc.)
* Proven track record of gathering, documenting, and prioritizing business and technical requirements
* Proficiency in tools like Power BI, SQL, and Azure DevOps/JIRA
* Strong stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem\-solving skills
* Agile/Scrum certification is a plus (e.g., CSPO, SAFe PO/PM)

* We have recently been ranked \#2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We are seeking an Agile Product Owner to lead the development and implementation of Consumer Servicing enhancements. jobs.title: SAP Data Products Solution Owner
jobs.description:
**Join us in building the future of Sandoz.**
 Through STEP (Sandoz Transformation Enterprise Program), we are creating a unified, integrated digital core and simplifying our end\-to\-end ways of working. From SAP S/4HANA to Veeva, Workday, LabVantage, and beyond, you’ll help design and deliver future\-ready systems that drive global impact — enabling us to deliver affordable medicines to more patients worldwide.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Develop and implement strategies \& roadmap for SAP data assets to support digital transformation goals. Manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of SAP data products and custom data solutions, ensuring they effectively meet evolving business needs, perform optimally, and are regularly improved to support digital objectives and data driven innovation.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
   

  

* Act as the central point of contact for all SAP content and custom data products, ensuring continuous alignment with business strategies and process requirements.
* Manage the entire lifecycle of SAP related data assets, ensuring re\-usability, overseeing downstream impact e.g. through data model version control
* Partners with other IT teams turning SAP data requirements into SAP enterprise data assets
* Identify and implement SAP Data Products in close alignment with SAP data architecture to support analytics insights and improve user experience by supporting emerging data needs.
* Drive design and management of all SAP data products in accordance with design \& architecture guidelines on data storage, processing and utilization including performance considerations.
* Analyze technical as well as data requirements and translate them into functional specifications for implementation in close alignment with enterprise archtecture standards
* Focus on physical data models, ensuring data governance and data integration for SAP BDC cloud\-based data solutions to meet business needs.
* 
* Collaborate with business process experts and cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless business solution implementations and integrations with downstream business applications.
* Focus on physical data models, ensuring data governance and data integration for SAP BDC cloud\-based data solutions to meet business needs.
* Ensure proper change management processes and drive data model versioning \& release deployments and effective data consumer skills / transparency on assets is in place
* Engage and manage stakeholders, fostering collaboration and alignment.
* Ensure SAP data products meet the organization’s security and GDPR requirements, including securing user roles and access control using SAP Identity Management (IdM) or SAP GRC.
* Collaborate with internal and external auditors to support compliance audits, leveraging SAP's audit logging capabilities and tracking of system changes to ensure data integrity
* Communicate complex data concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Minimum Requirements**
 What you’ll bring to the role:
   

  

* Proven experience in SAP related analytics and reporting as well as in SAP related data sources and products
* Engage and manage stakeholders at all levels of the organization, fostering collaboration and alignment on data\-related initiatives
* Definition and delivery of data models and execution of data strategies, in alignment with overarching data management principles
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in data management processes and technologies
* Foster clear data governance through experience in coordinating with both technical and functional teams.
* Familiarity with compliance and security standards relevant to the application.
* Strong understanding of data management and governance principles.
* Extensive knowledge of SAP technologies, with a proven track record of successful implementation and integration in the data analytics area
* Understanding of main technology features supporting data management and analytics
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
* Project management skills to oversee the development and delivery of data products.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills to address complex data challenges.
* Ability to align data products with business objectives and deliver measurable value.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology Business Administration, or related business field; (Master’s degree is preferred)


**Languages**
 English
   

  

**Why Sandoz?**
 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100\+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible\-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

**Join us!**
**\#Sandoz**

jobs.description:
**About Amgen**
 Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Role Description:**
* In this vital role, you will lead the preparation and delivery of commissioning and qualification (C\&Q) documentation that supports Engineering project execution and GMP manufacturing, packaging, and facility systems across Amgen’s operations.
* The Manager, C\&Q Document Preparation will lead a blended team of employees and contingent workers responsible for preparing compliant, inspection\-ready documentation that enables successful commissioning, qualification, and operational readiness of Engineering systems and capital projects.
* This role works closely with Engineering, Automation, Process Development, Validation, Quality, Manufacturing, Facilities, and Project teams to ensure documentation is delivered with high quality and aligned with project timelines.
* This position plays a key role in executing standardized C\&Q documentation practices within the Center of Excellence (CoE) and supporting consistent documentation quality across Engineering projects and sites.
* This position may support one or more areas including Drug Substance, Drug Product, Finished Drug Product \& Packaging, or Facilities \& Utilities.


**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
* Lead a team responsible for preparation and delivery of C\&Q documentation supporting commissioning and qualification activities across Engineering projects and systems.
* Manage work across a blended team of employees and contingent resources, ensuring effective planning, prioritization, and execution of deliverables.
* Oversee development of qualification protocols, reports, risk assessments, traceability matrices, and related qualification documentation.
* Execute C\&Q documentation preparation using established CoE standards, templates, and processes to ensure consistency, compliance, and efficiency.
* Partner with Engineering, Validation, Quality, Manufacturing, Facilities, and Project teams to support qualification execution and operational readiness activities.
* Monitor documentation progress, identify risks, and drive timely resolution of issues that may impact project timelines.
* Maintain inspection\-ready documentation and support regulatory inspections and internal audits as required.
* Support implementation of standardized C\&Q practices, templates, and procedures across Engineering projects and sites.
* Provide leadership, coaching, and development for team members while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and quality execution.

TJX Companies
   

  

 At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off\-price retailer.
   

  

****Job Description:****
 The TJX Companies, the leading off\-price apparel and home fashions retailer in the U.S. and the world is looking for a
 **Staff Product Owner (Workday)** 
 to join our Human Capital Management (HCM) Solution Delivery team which is responsible for software and systems that support TJX’s world\-class Global Human Resources and Payroll organizations. This role will guide the team that designs, configures, and delivers the Global Workday Human Capital Management solution.
   

  

****Job Description****
**What you’ll need**
 Our team thrives on strong relationships with our business partners and working to address their needs which support TJX strategic initiative and growth.  Our goal is to align IT delivery with business strategy.  We seek a motivated and talented Staff Product Owner to help guide the team supporting the Global Workday Human Capital Management solution.
   

  

**Ideal candidate:** 
 A collaborative and strategic Staff Product Owner with strong Workday HCM expertise who excels at translating complex HR business needs into clear, value\-driven solutions within an Agile framework. Proven ability to partner across business, product, and engineering teams to deliver scalable, compliant global HCM capabilities while managing priorities, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations effectively.
   

  

****Minimum Qualifications****
* 3 \+ years of experience as a Product Owner in an HCM environment supporting large complex project/product implementations, working directly with business owners to identify and prioritize their needs.
* Proven knowledge of agile methodology, scrum, SAFe, and agile tools (JIRA/Confluence).
* Practiced consultative partnership with customers, with the ability to translate functional needs into requirements that drive value
* Experience in defining/prioritizing a team backlog of user stories including acceptance criteria.

* Ability to manage dependencies and shifting priorities in and across sprints /PIs.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, tailoring to all audiences.
* HCM Workday experience required

* Ability to coordinate work with Product Manager, Product Analysts and Engineers.
* Partner with Product Managers to align on HCM initiatives with product strategy, roadmap priorities, and business outcomes, ensuring dependencies with downstream Workday modules are clearly understood and planned.
* Work closely with Product Analysts to gather, refine, and document business and functional requirements, translating complex HR processes into clear specifications for configuration and development.
* Collaborate with engineering throughout the design and delivery lifecycle to ensure functional requirements are technically feasible, well understood, and implemented according to Workday best practices.

 Oaktree is a leader among global investment managers specializing in alternative investments, with more than $220 billion in assets under management. The firm emphasizes an opportunistic, value\-oriented, and risk\-controlled approach to investments in credit, equity, and real estate. The firm has more than 1,400 employees and offices in more than 25 cities worldwide.

 As Vice President Product Engineering you will be joining our newly established Product Engineering group. This is a senior individual contributor role that will play a critical part in designing and building the next‑generation technology platform supporting Oaktree’s credit business—one of the firm’s largest and most sophisticated investment strategies.
   

  

* Hands\-on engineering role: Work directly in the codebase, solving complex problems and building production\-grade systems daily; ideal for engineers who prefer building over managing.

* Drive data\-informed decision\-making using metrics, telemetry, and experimentation.
* Clearly communicate technical trade\-offs to both engineering and business audiences.

* Strong foundation in computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, performance).
* Deep experience building data\-intensive systems, including pipeline design, data modeling, and large\-scale processing.
* Proficiency in Python and at least one compiled language (e.g., C\#, Java, Go, C\+\+, Scala).

* Comfortable working without traditional product management, engaging directly with stakeholders and navigating ambiguity.
* Strong written communication skills for effective asynchronous collaboration.
* Demonstrated product mindset, connecting technical work to business impact.
* Experience mentoring engineers and influencing without authority.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required.
* Advanced degree (MS, MBA) or equivalent experience in product\-focused engineering leadership preferred.

jobs.description:
Job Description


Senior Specialist, Product Analyst.

**The Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.


Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.


A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.

**Role Overview**


The Senior Specialist, Product Analyst is a critical member of the product team, responsible for translating business needs into scalable, high‑value digital product capabilities. This role operates at the intersection of business, technology, and data—partnering closely with product managers, engineering teams, site stakeholders, and external vendors to ensure solutions are clearly defined, prioritized, and delivered with measurable impact.


This is a **senior, hands‑on role** that requires strong product acumen, structured problem‑solving, and the ability to lead work independently across a complex, global stakeholder landscape.

**What will you do in this role**

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Who we are looking for**


The Global Liquidity Management (GLM) Group, within the Global Treasury organization, oversees State Street’s liquidity planning, monitoring, methodologies, analytics, and regulatory reporting globally. The group manages regulatory ratios such as the LCR, NSFR as well as the liquidity buffer requirements resulting from its Internal Liquidity Stress testing (ILST) and Recovery and Resolution planning (RRP) framework (RLAP/RLEN). The group is also responsible for ensuring compliance with all regulatory reporting requirement such as the daily FR2052a and associated public disclosures. We work collaboratively with the Global Treasury Risk Management (GTRM) function to ensure we are managing liquidity within firm policies, limits and risk tolerance while meeting regulatory expectations promulgated by the Federal Reserve, the FDIC and other regulators globally.


We are looking for an Assistant Vice President, Data Governance, who will lead the change management initiatives within liquidity reporting and data governance function. The person will be responsible for leading multiple change initiatives around the company’s liquidity risk management and optimization frameworks covering activities across the globe, including compliance with the relevant regulations. The position will report to the Liquidity Data Governance Lead.

**What you will be responsible for:**

  

* Subject matter expert on Treasury and Finance, Reg Reporting applications and functions providing techno/functional expertise within the Data Governance and Change Management team
* Drive in requirements gathering with upstream business functions and technology partners on database changes, system migrations, new product implementation, strategic remediation to data quality deficiencies.
* End to end implementation of business requirements inclusive of User Acceptance Testing to validate implementation against business needs
* Collaborate closely with technology and data teams to ensure reporting solutions are scalable, sustainable, and aligned to our GLM priorities.
* Lead projects and programs to support technology delivery aligned to business strategy in Treasury Liquidity domain.
* Additionally support other data governance initiatives like Data Lineage in Collibra, Data Quality Issue management, and improving reporting controls to ensure compliance to BCBS239 principles.
* This resource will work on key Regulatory and Treasury project initiatives primarily around liquidity reporting related changes. Resource should be having sound technical expertise in Reg Reporting domain, with Oracle Database, ETL process, SQL queries, Axiom Reporting experience.
* Possess strong tech skillset/experience in PL/SQL, Oracle databases, Python and project management process (agile, team player). This would require competency in all aspects of SDLC, and work with teams across the globe and be able to handle lead responsibility towards the project execution.
* Work with internal stakeholders and team members to expand and improve the data quality and accuracy of reporting and reduce any tactical workarounds in place through strategic remediations.

**What we value**

* Analytical thinker capable of breaking down complex problems into measurable parts
* Ability to proactively resolve issues by working with other teams
* Strong writing abilities and comfort drafting and reviewing procedures and policies
* Experience in preparing presentations for executive management and regulators
* Independent worker that takes ownership of responsibilities and holds their work to a higher standard

**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**

* 10\+ years of relevant experience in the financial services industry, with specific experience in Treasury Liquidity Reporting, Regulatory Reporting
* Degree in Finance from a tier one institution or CA/CPA will be preferable.
* Strong understanding of liquidity risk management principles and regulatory requirements (e.g., FR2052a reporting). .
* Change/Project Management Business Analyst experience in regulatory reporting area required
* Hands on technical experience working with finance technology including Axiom, Collibra, Oracle Databases, and data management BI Tools.
* Knowledge of regulatory reporting requirements specific to the Financial Services industry along with excellent Project Management skills
* Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools; ability to work with large datasets.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Are you the right candidate? Yes!**


We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don’t necessarily need you to fulfil all of them when applying. If you like change and innovation, seek to see the bigger picture, make data driven decisions and are a good team player, you could be a great fit.

**About State Street**
======================


Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.


We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. jobs.description:
In this role, we are seeking an experienced Senior Business Analyst with deep expertise in the fintech sector and a specialised focus on wealth management applications. You will act as the critical bridge between our business stakeholders, product managers, and engineering teams. You will translate complex financial concepts and wealth management workflows into clear, actionable technical requirements to build scalable, modern, and user\-centric wealth management platforms.
   

  

**The Candidate Will Have Responsibilities Across The Following Functions**
**Strategic Alignment and Requirements Gathering:**
* Partner with product managers, wealth advisors, and business stakeholders to understand the strategic vision for our wealth management applications.
* Lead workshops and discovery sessions to elicit, document, and analyse complex business requirements related to portfolio management, transactions, advisory, and client reporting.
* Translate high\-level business needs into detailed, development\-ready artefacts, including user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria, and process flow diagrams.


**Fintech And Wealth Management Subject Matter Expertise**
* Apply deep domain knowledge of wealth management lifecycles, including client onboarding (KYC/AML), asset allocation, portfolio rebalancing, performance reporting, and fee billing.
* Advise technical teams on financial instruments (equities, fixed income, derivatives, mutual funds/ETFs) and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Stay abreast of fintech trends, competitor products, and emerging technologies (e. g., AI in advisory, open banking APIs) to recommend product enhancements.


**Development Lifecycle And Execution (Agile)**
* Manage and groom the product backlog, ensuring user stories are prioritised, clearly defined, and accurately estimated.
* Collaborate closely with UX/UI designers to ensure platform interfaces meet the specialised needs of financial advisors and end\-investors.
* Act as the primary point of contact for the engineering and QA teams during development sprints, clarifying requirements and removing blockers.


**Testing, Implementation, And Support**
* Design and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) plans, ensuring the delivered software meets business needs and strict financial accuracy standards.
* Develop user manuals, release notes, and training materials for internal teams and end\-users.

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  

  

In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  

  

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  


AlloyDB is part of the Google Cloud Database area and focuses on Relational Databases (RDBMS) space a business opportunity and growth accelerator for other Google Cloud products. AlloyDB is a new enterprise grade, cloud native transactional database for high availability and performance. AlloyDB, combines the familiarity of open source PostgreSQL front\-end, with custom\-built storage and query engines for excellent availability, performance, security and manageability.  



  

In this role, you will contribute to both the database control plane and the database kernel, and additionally focus on integration with extended functionalities in the Google Cloud ecosystem, developer tooling and database clients. You will also focus on open source contributions from the project.
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Why this exists** 




 What if the app that handles your home's money actually understood how homes work? Fave is a UPI app built around homes, not individuals. Flatmates splitting rent and groceries. Dual\-income couples managing a household together. Families paying the cook, the maid, the driver. The everyday money that moves between the people you live with — finally in one place
 



  





**The role** 




 UPI apps today are utilities. Open, pay, close. Nobody thinks about them. Nobody talks about them. That's the gap. Fave is the chance to build a payments app people actually have feelings about. One that understands the weird, messy, real ways money moves inside a home — and makes all of it effortless. If we get this right, we're the operating layer for how Indian households manage money together. You'd own the product end\-to\-end. Not a feature. Not a pod. The whole thing — payments, household features, growth loops, monetization, whatever comes next. There's no VP of Product handing you a roadmap. You'd be shaping what Fave becomes. Day to day, you'll write specs that people actually want to read (yeah. writing is a good proxy for thinking, so we strongly encourage writing instead of generating). You'll think about how a payments screen becomes a reason someone tells their flatmate to download the app. You'll also build. Prototype a feature before writing the spec. Ship a growth hack over the weekend. Build an agent that automates a product ops workflow you're tired of doing manually. AI is how a small team punches above its weight — and you'll use it that way every day
 



  





**What you'll spend time on:** 




 Defining what Fave builds next — and, harder, what it doesn't Designing product experiences alongside our designer. You have taste. Use it Obsessing over activation and retention as much as shipping Thinking about distribution as a product problem: referrals, sharing moments, screenshots people actually post Talking to users constantly
 



  





**Who we're looking for** 




 We want instinct. The best PMs we've met don't reach for a prioritization matrix when they're stuck. They look at the product, talk to three users, and know. Frameworks are fine. But if that's where your conviction comes from, this isn't the role. 4\-6 years building consumer mobile apps. You've shipped things real people use daily You've been close to zero\-to\-one at least once. You know the difference between growing something that exists and willing something into existence Strong product taste — you notice when a flow is off, when copy is lazy, when an animation is 100ms too slow You think about distribution before you think about features. "How does this spread?" is always the first question AI\-native. You've built prototypes, automated workflows, or shipped something real using LLMs and AI tools. You treat AI as a multiplier on your output, not a novelty
 



  





**Bonus** 
 : You've worked at a company small enough that you couldn't hide behind process. You've made something go viral at least once, even if by accident.

 This Senior Product Manager will own the strategy for how SolarWinds defines, measures, and communicates the reliability and operational health of customer systems.  The core focus is transforming raw observability data into actionable, intelligent events and proactive health scores, directly enabling customer Service Level Objective (SLO) management and incident reduction.  This role drives the product vision for event correlation and anomaly detection, ensuring our platform moves customers from reactive monitoring to proactive incident prevention.  Success will be measured by the adoption of SLO features, the reduction in alert volume for customers, and the quality of system health scoring.
 



  

**Core Responsibilities:** 




 Define the product strategy and roadmap for Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs), ensuring seamless configuration, tracking, and reporting for our enterprise users.  Lead the development of the event management platform, focusing on advanced correlation, root cause analysis, and proprietary noise reduction techniques to combat alert fatigue.  Establish a unified, platform\-wide health and risk scoring model that synthesizes metrics, logs, and traces into a single, understandable view of system wellness.  Collaborate with machine learning and engineering teams to integrate AI\-driven anomaly detection and predictive alerting features for the proactive identification of impending issues.  Must be the voice of the Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) persona, translating industry best practices into powerful, simple\-to\-use product features.
 



  

**Required Qualifications:** 




 Deep domain expertise in AIOps, event management, and Service Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, with specific experience in defining and launching SLO/SLI features.  Proven experience in product managing technical platforms that leverage data science, machine learning, or statistical models for event correlation and anomaly detection.  Strong working knowledge of how observability data (metrics, logs, traces) is used to calculate system health and drive automated workflows.  Must possess impeccable oral and written communications skills, exceptional leadership capabilities to drive cross\-functional alignment, and proven expertise in product strategy and product management fundamentals.  Demonstrated ability to deliver features that fundamentally improve a customer’s operational efficiency and reduce Mean Time to Repair (MTTR).

**Non\-negotiable**

* You have led a data or AI team across engineering and science disciplines.

 We exist because the transition to electric mobility is one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of our generation. The people who join Driivz are here because they want to matter to that transition

**Responsibilities**

* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Self\-motivated, proactive and detail oriented.

**Job Description**
 You are a strategic thinker passionate about driving solutions in Business Management. You have found the right team.
   

  

 As a Business Management team member within the Commercial Banking Executive Business Management Team, you will support Commercial Banking–Investment Banking partnership initiatives, ensure alignment with evolving data privacy and confidentiality requirements, and enable senior management decision\-making through clear reporting and analysis. You will partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to represent business management priorities, promote best practices across C\&SI teams, and deliver high\-impact projects in a collaborative, growth\-oriented environment.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Oversee reporting, ad\-hoc projects, strategic initiatives, and analytics solutions with minimal supervision, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery.
* Serve as a liaison between Business Management, analytics teams, and senior stakeholders, translating complex concepts for non\-technical audiences.
* Drive process improvements and automation by implementing innovative solutions across Business Management and analytics functions.
* Oversee data management activities to ensure accuracy and compliance, and enhance workflows using new tools and technologies.
* Lead requirements gathering and detailed project planning while managing multiple initiatives and prioritizing tasks and resources.
* Conduct control testing and validation of analytics and Business Management solutions.
* Lead business review processes by synthesizing data into actionable insights for senior management.
* Collaborate with IT, end\-users, and business partners during solution development, UAT, and production migration.
* Identify and escalate risks and opportunities across Business Management and analytics processes.
* Draft procedures, communications, and meeting minutes, and coordinate or deliver training for bankers and business stakeholders as needed.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Chartered Accountant/CFA/MBA (or similar educational background) with 1 years of relevant experience in Finance, Business Management, and Analytics.
* Advanced MS Excel and MS PowerPoint skills.
* Intermediate, hands\-on experience with Business Intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, Qlik, ThoughtSpot) and programming/query tools (e.g., SQL, Python).
* Intermediate understanding of Planning \& Analysis (P\&A), banking and product concepts, data analytics, data modeling, and automation.
* Proven ability to deliver high\-quality analysis, reporting, and data visualizations.
* Intermediate project management skills.
* Strong client partnership and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to articulate effectively across levels and functions.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Previous experience in business management, control management, and/or project management.
* Experience organizing and delivering training sessions.
* Familiarity with regulatory requirements and best practices in financial services.
* Ability to maintain high performance on high\-demand, time\-sensitive initiatives with a positive, solution\-oriented approach.

 At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future\-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.
   

  

 Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. * Understand the business justification for the product, client’s vision, and future scope.
* Create functional design documents and other documentation required as part of GxP documentation process and work closely with the Quality and Validation teams ensuring timely approvals are obtained.
* Ensure documentation remains audit‑ready, consistent, and aligned with development and Quality expectations.
* Maintain Confluence spaces with updated feature details, design notes, and process artifacts.
* Support test case preparation through creation of test scenarios and acceptance tests that align with documented requirements.
* Assist with UAT planning and coordinate with business users to validate feature readiness.
* Perform initial root‑cause assessment for functional issues by reviewing logs, data, and workflows.

jobs.description:
**Description**
 Amazon is shaping the future of digital video entertainment in India. We seek a BA II for our team who can help us scale Amazon MX Player, Amazon India's free ad\-supported (AVOD) streaming service. Over the next few months, we plan to launch a large number of exclusive shows and new content.
   

  

 Over the past decade Amazon has developed a number of market\-leading, innovative and fast\-growing digital and mobile businesses, including: Amazon Prime Video, Amazon Prime Music, Echo, Alexa and Kindle. This is an exciting opportunity for an entrepreneurial minded candidate who wants to work in a start\-up like environment and is passionate about digital media and new customer experiences.
   

  

 We are looking for an analytical leader who can build and scale the data streams for a digital video business in India He/She will work in a highly collaborative environment, and be responsible for working both with the local teams in India as well as the Global teams in Seattle \& other locales.
   

  

 This role will be responsible for building and maintaining end\-to\-end analytics solutions that drive business decisions. The ideal candidate will have a track record of navigating successfully through ambiguity, gathering business requirements and creating BI and analytics solutions that have measurable customer impact, and demonstrating exemplary written and verbal communication skills. The candidate will have to set the right vision, strategy and roadmap and work alongside with stakeholders in the organization to make it happen. The candidate knows and loves working with business intelligence tools, can model multidimensional datasets, and can partner effectively with business leaders to answer key business questions. S/he will need to be a self\-starter, comfortable with ambiguity in a fast\-paced and ever\-changing environment, and be able to lead a team to innovate and think big, while diving deep to meet our bar for quality and accuracy.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Duties \& Responsibilities For This Role Will Include**
 Design, implement, and support key datasets that provide structured and timely access to actionable business information
   

  

 Set up the data lake for a new video streaming business
   

  

 Owning the design, development, and maintenance of ongoing metrics, reports, analyses, dashboards, etc. to drive key business decisions.
   

  

 Developing expertise across various business teams, to drive adoption and increase visibility into key measures of business performance.
   

  

 Proposing and prioritizing changes to key metric reporting, creating additional metrics and processes based on program changes and customer requirements, and owning the data presented.
   

  

 Interfacing with business customers to gather data and metrics requirements, then driving analytic projects which will help solve complex challenges.
   

  

 Perform deep\-dives to find the root causes behind variances of key parameters.
   

  

 Analyzing data and driving insights related to operation and compliance.
   

  

 Investigate and implement new big data technologies to provide automatic resolutions to address stakeholder needs.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 5\+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
* Experience in data warehouse technical architectures, data modeling, infrastructure components, ETL/ ELT and reporting/analytic tools and environments, data structures and hands\-on SQL coding
* Business Intelligence systems and data presentation (Tableau, MicroStrategy, PowerBI, QuickSight)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Working knowledge of Python/Java or similar coding languages.
* Familiarity with AWS solutions such as Redshift, S3\.
* Have ability to independently influence and drive outputs, meet deadlines, and set clear expectations and roadmaps.
* MBA or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance or related field.
* Experience in projects involving complex data sets and high variability.
* A history of teamwork and willingness to roll up one’s sleeves to get the job done.
* Excellent communication (verbal and written) and interpersonal skills and an ability to effectively communicate with both business and technical teams.
* Experience handling confidential and sensitive data.
* Design and develop data infrastructure to support business growth
